title: Conditionnel passé
goal: By the end of this lesson you can form the conditionnel passé and use it to express regrets, reproaches, missed possibilities and unconfirmed news, especially with j'aurais dû, j'aurais pu and j'aurais aimé.

learn.h: Formation: conditional of avoir/être + past participle
body: The conditionnel passé is a compound tense: the conditionnel présent of *avoir* or *être* + the past participle. It means 'would have done'.

Use *être* with the same verbs as in the passé composé (movement verbs like *aller, venir, partir, arriver*, and all pronominal verbs), with the same agreement rules: *Elle serait venue. Nous nous serions amusés.*
learn.tip: Passé composé with the auxiliary in the conditional: j'ai parlé → j'aurais parlé.

learn.h: Should have, could have, would have liked
body: Three combinations are extremely common and worth learning as chunks:
*J'aurais dû* + infinitive = I should have: *J'aurais dû partir plus tôt.*
*J'aurais pu* + infinitive = I could have / might have: *Tu aurais pu m'appeler!* (reproach) *Ça aurait pu être pire.*
*J'aurais aimé / voulu* + infinitive or *que* + subjunctive = I would have liked: *J'aurais aimé te voir. J'aurais voulu que tu sois là.*

body: The conditionnel passé describes what would have happened if things had been different: *Sans ton aide, j'aurais abandonné.* (Without your help, I would have given up.) *À ta place, je serais resté.* (In your shoes, I would have stayed.)
With *si*, it pairs with the plus-que-parfait (type 3, next week): *Si j'avais su, je serais venu.* Never put the conditional after *si*.

Journalists use the conditionnel passé for past facts that are not yet confirmed: *Selon la police, le suspect aurait pris la fuite vers les États-Unis.* = According to police, the suspect reportedly fled to the U.S.
In English this is 'reportedly', 'allegedly', 'is said to have'. It's a key reading skill for Radio-Canada and La Presse.
It is also the 'future in the past' for completed actions in reported speech: *Il a dit qu'il aurait fini avant midi.*

learn.h: Quebec: j'aurais dû, t'aurais pu, and a famous movie line
body: In casual Quebec speech, *tu aurais* contracts to *t'aurais* and *ça aurait* to *ç'aurait* [sɔrɛ]: *T'aurais pu m'avertir!* *Ç'aurait été le fun!* (*le fun* = fun, enjoyable).

Every Quebecer knows the line *« Si j'aurais su, j'aurais pas venu »* from the 1984 film *La Guerre des tuques*. It's quoted as a joke precisely because it contains two classic errors: *si j'aurais* (standard: *si j'avais*) and *j'aurais venu* (standard: *je serais venu*). The correct sentence: *Si j'avais su, je ne serais pas venu.*

examples.en: According to police, the suspect reportedly fled.

examples.en: I wish you had been there.

examples.fr: Il a promis qu'il aurait terminé avant vendredi.
examples.en: He promised he would have finished before Friday.

examples.fr: Ç'aurait été le fun de faire du ski ensemble.
examples.en: It would have been fun to go skiing together.

quebec.intro: Quebecers use 'j'aurais dû' and 't'aurais pu' constantly, with contracted pronouns. And everyone quotes the playful error 'Si j'aurais su, j'aurais pas venu' from La Guerre des tuques; know why it's wrong.

dialogue.fr: T'étais où samedi? On t'a attendu au party!
dialogue.en: Where were you on Saturday? We waited for you at the party!

dialogue.fr: Je sais, désolé. J'aurais dû t'écrire. Mon auto est tombée en panne.
dialogue.en: I know, sorry. I should have texted you. My car broke down.
You could have taken a taxi!

dialogue.en: I thought about it, but it would have cost sixty bucks.

dialogue.en: Too bad. It would have been fun, everyone was there.

dialogue.en: I'd really have liked to see Julie. Has she gone back to France?

speak.prompt: Name three regrets about the past year using j'aurais dû, j'aurais pu and j'aurais aimé.
speak.model: J'aurais dû faire plus de sport. J'aurais pu voyager en Gaspésie. J'aurais aimé passer plus de temps avec mes amis.

speak.prompt: Gently reproach a friend who didn't tell you something important.
speak.model: Voyons, t'aurais pu me le dire! Je t'aurais aidé.

speak.prompt: Correct the famous line and explain the two errors: 'Si j'aurais su, j'aurais pas venu.'
speak.model: Si j'avais su, je ne serais pas venu. Après si, on met le plus-que-parfait, et venir se conjugue avec être.

write.prompt: Write 5–6 sentences about a day that went wrong (missed flight, forgotten appointment…). Say what you should have done, could have done, and what would have happened otherwise.
write.model: Mardi, j'ai raté mon avion pour Vancouver. J'aurais dû partir de chez moi deux heures avant, mais je suis parti trop tard. J'aurais pu prendre le 747, l'autobus de l'aéroport, mais j'ai choisi l'auto. Il y avait un bouchon énorme sur l'autoroute 20. Si j'étais parti plus tôt, je serais arrivé à temps. Ça m'aurait évité de payer un nouveau billet!
